name: DEVOTE
source:
Suddenly after school main character is called to the class with four girls. The girls asked to make love to them. At first main character thought it was a joke, but that was a serious request. And so began their after-classes experiences.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
放学后突然主角和四个女孩被叫到班级。女孩们要求和他们做爱。起初主角以为这是一个玩笑，但这是一个严肃的要求。他们的课后经历就这样开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
